paper_title: 高速公路应急车道紧急启用模型

argumentation_roles.lesson: Use architecture diagrams only to explain implementation; prove detector/tracker quality with held-out detection/tracking metrics and calibration evidence.
Plot flow/speed/density with a shared timebase and units; preserve timestamp alignment from raw video through aggregation.
Ablation tables are useful, but require leakage-free chronological/group holdout and worst-group metrics; do not summarize only the best site.
Plot signed wave speed separately from nonnegative travel time and show state-machine thresholds/hysteresis on the same timeline.
Plot candidate post-opening states on the same Greenshields curve; reject states that do not lie on the governing model.
Map candidate sites with cost/coverage/state-estimation/control-value metrics; a prose spacing recommendation is not an optimization figure.
